name: Vibe Chat (Mistral)
tagline: AI assistant and models from Mistral AI
description: Vibe is Mistral AI's assistant, available on the web, in a CLI and IDE and on mobile, with a free plan, paid individual and team plans, and a separate pay-as-you-go API for Mistral's models. The catalog previously listed this product as Le Chat; Mistral's own site now calls it Vibe.
features: Web search, image generation and editing
Coding sessions in CLI, IDE and web
strengths: A free plan with Vibe CLI and Mistral Studio access (per the FAQ)
Pro includes $15 per month of API credits
limitations: Free plan has limited messages, web searches and coding sessions
Feature-table values for some limits were not clearly mapped to plans on the page

plans.name: Pro
highlights: All-day coding in CLI, IDE and web
plans.note: Excluding taxes. Annual pricing not stated

plans.name: Education (Pro for students)
plans.note: The page lists $14.99; the FAQ says verified students can get Pro for $5.99 per month

plans.name: Team
highlights: Up to 30 GB storage per user
plans.note: Excluding taxes. A separate '$50 /mo' figure appears with an unclear label

plans.name: Enterprise
highlights: Audit logs, SAML SSO, white label

free.details: Limited messages and web searches, limited coding sessions, basic image generation and editing, 100+ connectors.

api.summary: Mistral Large is $0.50 per million input tokens and $1.50 per million output tokens. Batch processing is 50% cheaper and cached input tokens up to 90% cheaper. OCR, speech and tool APIs have their own units.

pricing.regional: The page offers USD and EUR selectors and an 'including taxes' view; EUR amounts and regional differences were not captured.

verification.notes: Product active but renamed: chat.mistral.ai now opens as 'Vibe Chat' (tab title and 'Vibe Terms of Service'), and the pricing page describes 'Vibe' on web, CLI, IDE and mobile. The catalog name was 'Le Chat'; the display name is updated and the id is unchanged. USD view: Free $0; Pro $14.99/month (student plan available); Team $24.99 per user/month; Enterprise custom; amounts exclude tax. The sign-in and terms prompt was not accepted.
verification.method: Opened in the Claude desktop built-in browser; page text read

profile.headline: Vibe: Mistral's AI assistant for work and coding agent, formerly Le Chat

capabilities.title: Brief it and move on
capabilities.text: Think through, draft and deliver finished work from one conversation.

capabilities.title: Catch up across your sources
capabilities.text: Get briefed on email, chat, calendar and internal knowledge in one run.

capabilities.title: Run deep research
capabilities.text: Search the web, internal documents and connected tools for sourced analysis.

capabilities.title: Write and test code
capabilities.text: Vibe for code builds features end to end, generates and runs tests, and delegates overnight coding to async agents that open pull requests.

featureCards.name: Analyse your data
featureCards.text: Upload spreadsheets or connect databases to spot patterns and anomalies.

featureCards.name: Schedule recurring workflows
featureCards.text: Move work between systems and process or approve in bulk, with human checkpoints.

featureCards.name: 100+ connected tools
featureCards.text: Email, calendar, Slack, GitHub and Jira, through connectors and MCP.

featureCards.name: Migration help for code
featureCards.text: Translate to modern frameworks, migrate and upgrade dependencies.

audienceDetail.text: A Free plan exists for personal use.
Vibe for code runs in a CLI and in VS Code, JetBrains or Zed.
Enterprise adds on-premises or private-cloud deployment and fine-tuning through Mistral Forge.

scenarios.title: Brief yourself on a client meeting
scenarios.text: Build a one-page brief with attendee context and talking points.

scenarios.title: Clear your inbox
scenarios.text: Summarise unread emails and draft replies.

scenarios.title: Research AI news
scenarios.text: Run deep research and read the sourced result.

gettingStarted.text: Or launch Vibe in VS Code, JetBrains or Zed through ACP.
Start with remote agents in Vibe and carry on in the CLI.
